profile.title: Professional Profile
profile.text1: I am a Systems and Information Technology Engineering student with a minor in Data Analysis with Computer Tools. My profile combines software development, databases, data analysis, information security and technology infrastructure.

items.title: Quality Management and Reporting Web System
items.description: Academic team project developed to manage quality certification processes in a flour manufacturing company. The application allows users to manage accounts, clients, laboratory equipment, and technical parameters, as well as record quality analyses, generate PDF certificates, and visualize statistical reports with charts and summary tables.
items.imageAlt: Web system interface for certification management, quality analysis, and statistical reporting

items.title: Predictive Analysis of Hospital Discharges
items.description: Academic project focused on exploratory analysis, data cleaning, and modeling of hospital discharge data to evaluate patterns associated with patient outcomes. The project included variable transformation, data visualization, training and testing set partitioning, classification model training, and performance metric interpretation.
items.imageAlt: Conceptual visualization of predictive analysis applied to hospital data

items.title: Dynamic Website for Casa Pestalozzi
items.description: Development of a dynamic website for Casa Pestalozzi, focused on communicating the restaurant’s gastronomic concept, organizing its commercial content, and improving the user browsing experience. The project includes key sections such as restaurant, bakery, events, visual menu, contact, and direct reservations.
